description: This file is a PHP web page that manages the QoS (Quality of Service) settings for a network device, including WMM for Wi-Fi and MoCA QoS. It includes server-side logic to retrieve current settings and client-side JavaScript to initialize UI elements and save configuration changes via AJAX.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the checkbox UI elements based on current QoS settings for WMM and MoCA.

methods.name: saveQoS
methods.description: Sends the QoS configuration data to the server via AJAX for saving.
